change_correlation.commit: 90a73316 NE-237: unlock five selectable melee continuations and preserve resource/recovery costs
change_correlation.player_changed: Introduced MeleeCommandInput and replaced the simulation-delta melee buffer countdown with an absolute Time.get_ticks_msec deadline.
change_correlation.diagnosis: Strong timing-regression candidate, not reproduced locally: a wall-clock deadline can expire before the cancel window is reached when CI process scheduling is delayed. All three CI failures follow from the same expired buffered command; 41 frames is consistent with waiting through the combo window after the chain was missed. Local Godot 4.7.2 targeted suite passes; the CI failure was Godot 4.7-stable on Linux, so runtime/scheduling differences remain unisolated.
